## v1.15.0 — 2026-03-26

This release focuses on security hardening and pentest remediation, introducing organizational controls, billing email improvements, atomic publishing, and comprehensive fixes for SSRF, XSS, IDOR vulnerabilities along with HSTS implementation and health endpoint security.

### ✨ Features

- Added organizational controls including org gate functionality and self-approval restrictions
- Implemented atomic publish functionality to ensure data consistency during publishing operations

### 🔧 Improvements

- Enhanced billing emails system with improved functionality and reliability
- Implemented HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) headers for enhanced connection security

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerabilities identified during penetration testing
- Resolved Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) security vulnerabilities
- Fixed Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerabilities to prevent unauthorized access
- Secured health endpoint to prevent information disclosure
- Added unsafe-inline directive to Content Security Policy script-src to support necessary inline scripts

### Contributors

@mttaylor
